Jordan —

Appreciate the demo last week. LaunchFoundry is ramping 6 startups into our summer cohort and several teams hit a blocker integrating embeddings at scale. We realize you may need approvals for credits and compliance signoff (SOC2 / DPA). Can you confirm what you need from our side and a rough timeline? We can provide the security contact and a usage template.

Thanks — Sohail

Hi all —

Thanks Jordan and Sohail. Quick compliance/controls notes:
- SOC2: we can provide the SOC2 Type II summary + evidence bundle on a secure link; we will also sign a standard Redwood DPA addendum.
- Credits: We typically create a provisional promo voucher tied to a deal id; the voucher will be redeemable by the three accounts you list. If the milestone is not validated at the 45-day mark, the voucher will be void.
- PO / billing: If LaunchFoundry requires a formal PO to issue the voucher, we can accept that, otherwise the voucher will be issued subject to Redwood's promo T&Cs and a simple MAA (Master Addendum Amendment).

Action items for LaunchFoundry:
1) Provide the three account emails and indicate which team contact will confirm milestone usage.
2) Confirm whether you need a PO or prefer the MAA + voucher route.
3) Provide security contact for SOC2 transfer.

I have attached a provisional voucher draft (PDF) for internal review. Once legal signs the MAA we can activate the voucher immediately. Mateo — please prepare an onboarding checklist and flag any rate-limit/batch settings the cohort might need.

Thanks —
